title: ACIS peer status, ezdxf documentation conflict, and local disposition audit

method.kind: Primary-source web review plus local source/test audit
method.localEzdxfAvailability: not installed: python3 import failed with ModuleNotFoundError; no install or network fetch attempted
method.evidenceRule: Mutable peer reports and documentation establish only their named revision, declared API, or reported loss shape. No current release behavior, independent semantic correctness, B-rep validity, or native application acceptance is established without pinned execution and independent checks.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG AcDs loss report and source boundary
evidence.observed: Issue #1411 remains open and reports R2018 SAB loss for LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit 8a1ae764. The report distinguishes the surviving entity shell from payload carried in AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b. Current master source contains an R2007+ AcDs-section read path, while NEWS describes remaining datastore/extraction limitations.
doesNotEstablish: That the issue's exact generated repro fails on a later source revision
Complete current-master AcDs parsing, owner/key association, or writing
Valid ACIS geometry or independent B-rep semantics
evidence.planUse: At the existing optional checkpoint only, pin exact source and binary and inspect section, entity-to-owner/key join, exact payload, and strict reread on temporary locally generated input.

evidence.observed: Issue #1195 remains open and reports silent omission in ACadSharp 3.4.9. PRs #1150 and #1240 remain open; #1150 proposes writing modeler payloads to DXF/DWG, while #1240 proposes ACIS-dependent entity writing and depends on #1174. GitHub reports #1240 as undeployed. PR #1174 remains open, and its Aug 12 branch-test comment reports the owner-payload test failed at readAcdsRecord with NotImplementedException.
doesNotEstablish: Current behavior on ACadSharp master or a current release
Merged/deployed completion of any proposed fix
A local libdxfrw defect or semantic ACIS correctness
Public availability of the issue's customer DWGs
evidence.planUse: Keep these as version/branch-specific evidence and retain local per-entity, per-block, payload, and readback disposition checks. Do not fetch the customer drawings.

evidence.topic: ezdxf API documentation conflict and bounded generation route
evidence.observed: The specific ACIS API page documents body_from_mesh() and export_dxf() for known polyhedra, SAT for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013/R2018. The same page limits parsing to a subset and explicitly states that ezdxf has no ACIS kernel and cannot round-trip arbitrary ACIS. The FAQ conflicts by saying only SAT can be written and no ACIS creation is provided. The drawing add-on does not render ACIS and has no 3D engine.
doesNotEstablish: Exact behavior of an unpinned local ezdxf artifact
Independent semantic validation when the same package generated and parsed the carrier
Curved B-rep support, kernel validity, or native consumer acceptance
evidence.planUse: Prefer the specific API reference over the stale FAQ for the existing optional generator; pin package/runtime and capture emitted version, SAT/SAB type, parameters, and exact hash. Use a distinct admitted reader plus independently computed expectations for semantics.

evidence.observed: Official Draft DXF documentation says embedded ACIS solids cannot currently be read by stock FreeCAD's DXF import path; issue #18454 discusses the proprietary ACIS blob boundary.
doesNotEstablish: Any ACIS semantic support in stock FreeCAD
evidence.planUse: Keep native FreeCAD checks scoped to explicit 2D/entity conversion; gate any ACIS-capable consumer separately.

evidence.observed: tests/modeler_dxf_writer_matrix_tests.cpp already exercises 3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY over ASCII and Binary DXF for AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1027; it verifies record tags/readback and a following LINE. Marker payloads establish carriage and boundary behavior only. Surface round-trip cases are separate.
doesNotEstablish: Downstream CAD rendering or solid construction
evidence.planUse: Close the one-time audit with no duplicate BODY case or new CTest lane; preserve the existing fast matrix as typed-carrier and record-boundary evidence.

assertionsAdded: Unique expected history, evaluation-graph, and operation proxy handles and class ids

limitations: Peer repositories and mutable documentation were not pinned to immutable source revisions.
No peer or native runtime was installed or run.
The generated polyhedron candidate was not executed; no generated input was added.
The optional ezdxf generator was unavailable locally; the implementation self-unblocked to existing local tests and plan work.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty and the slice is uncommitted; unrelated state was not staged or altered.
The six deferred external items remain non-promoting.
